title: Quantum Mechanics for Engineers
description:
Prerequisite: MATH241 and PHYS270.
Restriction: Permission of ENGR-Materials Science & Engineering department. Provides engineering students with a foundational understanding of quantum mechanics and its practical applications in the field of materials science. This course will equip students with the essential knowledge and skills required to harness the principles of quantum mechanics in their pursuit of innovative solutions in materials science and engineering.
